claims: The frozen fixtures explicitly mark fiction, exclude consent claims, bind evidence-specific audiences and semantic receipts, constrain source-to-subject capability, and reject ordinary relabelling, sparse arrays and thrown accessors without throwing.

The runtime and canonical validators both accept a malformed currentClaims container whose live claim has kind fabricated, subjectScope real_person and audience public when an array-level toJSON function returns the benign derived view.

The bypass exists because currentClaims elements receive only nonempty-string shape checks plus a status enumeration before JSON.stringify is trusted for derivation equality. Kind, subjectScope and audience are not enumerated independently, and the array is not restricted to plain index-only data.
The accepted live claim can therefore relabel the claim subject and widen private audience metadata while both validators report success, triggering SAFETY-RANGE-01.
